programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: 'S1/E4 - Berlin'. Josh embarks upon two days of adventures in historic Berlin, where hidden treasures include an abandoned garage and a former U.S. Spy Station used during the Cold War.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - Igor Zaripov'. Thom heads to Nevada, to find a man who defies human biology. Igor Zaripov performs mind-blowing feats of power using only the might of his jaw.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans
programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - Scott Flansburg'. Thom's in Nevada, tracking down world record-holding mathlete Scott Flansburg, who's able to crunch numbers faster than a calculator.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Jerry Miculek'. Thom heads to Louisiana to meet Jerry Miculek, the human machine gun who can fire a handgun faster than an automatic weapon.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans
programme.desc: 'S2/E6 - Dean Karnazes'. Thom Hunt heads to Nevada, to meet Dean Karnazes, an ultramarathon runner who's taken endurance running to a level that defies human biology.

programme.title: Planet Insect
